49707.note: Downtown Pensacola waterfront seafood house that absorbed the neighboring Atlas Oyster House, keeping Atlas's Tuesday oyster nights.

50075.note: Perdido Key raw bar focused on fresh oysters and seafood.

50091.note: Oyster bar inside the Flora-Bama roadhouse on the state line, home of the Interstate Mullet Toss.
50091.fn: Flora-Bama's own site and Visit Pensacola give 1964 for the roadhouse on the Florida-Alabama line.

50092.note: Waterfront oyster bar and marina off River Road near Perdido Key serving oysters, gumbo and fried platters.

50304.note: Pensacola Beach oyster bar with its own marina out back, serving raw and baked oysters and several Gulf grouper dishes; live music Saturday nights.

50308.note: Pensacola Beach seafood restaurant on Santa Rosa Sound with a shucked-to-order oyster bar and a menu printed daily around the local catch.
50308.fn: The restaurant's own site says it opened in April 2010.
